title: Do political connections and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance affect the relationship between climate change risk and audit efforts?
core_idea: Investigate whether climate change risk disclosures influence auditors' workload and whether political connections and ESG performance moderate that relationship, using data from Egyptian non-financial firms and multiple regression analysis.
tldr: Tests the impact of climate risk disclosures on auditors' effort and the moderating roles of political connections and ESG in Egyptian non-financial firms (2017–2022) using regression methods.
